hero.eyebrow: NFC business cards with a built-in pipeline
hero.title: Share your card with a tap. Keep every lead it brings.
hero.subtitle: Put your digital business card on an NFC chip or a QR code. Whoever taps it sees your card in their browser, with no app to install, and the details they leave go straight to your pipeline.

product.label: Product
product.title: Everything between the tap and the deal
product.subtitle: One workspace for your cards, the chips that open them and the people they bring in.

card.title: A card that is always current
card.body: Choose one of 19 templates, add your contact buttons and links, and publish. Change anything later: the chip and the QR code always open the latest version.

chips.title: Chips you control
chips.body: Point a chip at another card without rewriting it, hand it to a teammate, or switch it off if it is lost.

leads.title: Leads without typing
leads.body: Visitors leave their details, or ask for a meeting or a quote, right from your card. Each request arrives as a lead, with the card it came from.

pipeline.title: One pipeline for the whole team
pipeline.body: Seven stages from New to Won, as a board or a table, with notes, tasks and a score on every lead.

analytics.title: Numbers you can act on
analytics.body: Views, taps, saves and clicks for every card, compared with the period before, and a CSV whenever you need one.

team.title: Made for teams
team.body: Owners, admins, managers and members each see what their role allows. Everyone gets their own card and chip.

items.save: Save to contacts in one tap
items.qr: A QR code for every card
items.profiles: Several profiles on one link, by schedule or passcode

how.label: How it works
how.title: From the first tap to the follow-up

create.title: Make your card
create.body: Pick a template, add your details and the buttons you want people to press.

share.title: Put it on a chip
share.body: Link an NFC chip or print the QR code. A tap or a scan opens your card on any phone.

follow.title: Follow up
follow.body: Everyone who leaves their details appears in your pipeline, and you get a notification.

pricing.label: Pricing
pricing.title: Start free. Pay when your team grows.
pricing.subtitle: The pipeline, analytics and integrations come with every plan. Plans differ in how many cards, members and chips you can have.
pricing.note: Prices are in US dollars, billed monthly. You can change your plan at any time from Billing.

app.q: Does the other person need an app?
app.a: No. Your card opens in their phone's browser, whether they tap the chip or scan the QR code.

phones.q: Which phones can read the chip?
phones.a: Recent iPhones and most Android phones read NFC chips without an app; on Android, NFC has to be switched on. Any phone with a camera can scan the QR code.

change.q: Can I change my card after the chip is printed?
change.a: Yes. The chip holds a fixed link, so whatever you change on the card shows on the next tap. You can also point the chip at a different card.

lost.q: What if a chip is lost?
lost.a: Disable it from NFC chips. A disabled chip opens nothing until you enable it again.

leads.q: Where do the details people leave go?
leads.a: Into Leads, as a new lead in the first stage of your pipeline, with the card it came from. You get a notification too.

arabic.a: Yes. Each card can be in Arabic or English, and the whole workspace can be used in either language.

cta.title: Your first card takes a few minutes.
cta.body: Start on the free plan, and upgrade when you need more cards, members or chips.

footer.tagline: NFC business cards, and a pipeline for the leads they bring.
